Joby Aviation completed its first fully autonomous cross-country flight, covering 3,199 miles without pilot intervention [1](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNdzMyZDlTX2h6OVlwb3FmZV9FaU10TVJhclVOSFU0ZFN3VzljYjRhZ0Q0bWFwd1FRSlh0TUNGb2psckdic0FrcVJUTFZtMk9uM1BqbzdTNXZkOXJiRUhOSDdNcGQ0MW1YRXVWeEpSbFhoODFwVFUxZzV2ZWx2X2t6SQ?oc=5). The Federal Communications Commission cleared a nationwide test of cellular networks for drones to determine if they can serve as the backbone of the drone fleet [2](https://dronedj.com/2026/09/23/fcc-drone-cellular-network-5g/). The Coast Guard formed a new program office to oversee robotics and autonomous systems [3](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxNc29vMUs2dkxQMnJNN3lESXVnZlVXYnpYMGNTUmxDUlJfMU8xZjg5WWlNYVJPRGNOR2dLSUdvaGprVVZxdjJCSUh1WU1xMmZ6UEtKd2dGbzlfYzE4U1hFaUhfbWl6aDZfamJTVzJaZkRyWmNyQ3hjZnNSZ2oxRlN0b0o0ekxNLVhMaTA2WE1zc3hxN24tZWc?oc=5).

Beta Technologies launched operations under the federal eVTOL Integration Pilot Program in North Carolina, focusing on rural healthcare access [1](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNdzMyZDlTX2h6OVlwb3FmZV9FaU10TVJhclVOSFU0ZFN3VzljYjRhZ0Q0bWFwd1FRSlh0TUNGb2psckdic0FrcVJUTFZtMk9uM1BqbzdTNXZkOXJiRUhOSDdNcGQ0MW1YRXVWeEpSbFhoODFwVFUxZzV2ZWx2X2t6SQ?oc=5). Authorities are investigating Comma AI's hands-off driving technology following fatal crashes [4](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQTGlOYzNXWmFqTTctVUxuemUyZXNJU2xMeS1fWkxMVUVteF90OUdwUGFPdkJNcVlfRHlVdTU3dGI1SjlpLWVsN3FEYkVZT2JQQk5PQU5sSUVVZGg3RnVKNzNiYUxxRWlhVzZrcmhneG4zRi1sUXp4SFBpY001RXNINkpCTFNJM3JzaUE?oc=5). Tesla is reportedly operating its Robotaxi service in Texas with an expired state license [4](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQTGlOYzNXWmFqTTctVUxuemUyZXNJU2xMeS1fWkxMVUVteF90OUdwUGFPdkJNcVlfRHlVdTU3dGI1SjlpLWVsN3FEYkVZT2JQQk5PQU5sSUVVZGg3RnVKNzNiYUxxRWlhVzZrcmhneG4zRi1sUXp4SFBpY001RXNINkpCTFNJM3JzaUE?oc=5). Aurora targets 30,000 driverless trucks by 2030, while Waymo launched driverless rides in Tampa [4](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxQTGlOYzNXWmFqTTctVUxuemUyZXNJU2xMeS1fWkxMVUVteF90OUdwUGFPdkJNcVlfRHlVdTU3dGI1SjlpLWVsN3FEYkVZT2JQQk5PQU5sSUVVZGg3RnVKNzNiYUxxRWlhVzZrcmhneG4zRi1sUXp4SFBpY001RXNINkpCTFNJM3JzaUE?oc=5).

China is testing a supersonic jet to reduce Beijing-Shanghai travel time by 75% for a 1,075-km trip [5](https://news.google.?oc=5). The Department of Defense plans a counter-drone laser shoot-off in December [3](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxNc29vMUs2dkxQMnJNN3lESXVnZlVXYnpYMGNTUmxDUlJfMU8xZjg5WWlNYVJPRGNOR2dLSUdvaGprVVZxdjJCSUh1WU1xMmZ6UEtKd2dGbzlfYzE4U1hFaUhfbWl6aDZfamJTVzJaZkRyWmNyQ3hjZnNSZ2oxRlN0b0o0ekxNLVhMaTA2WE1zc3hxN24tZWc?oc=5). Marines are fielding LMADIS counter-drone MRZRs in CENTCOM [3](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxNc29vMUs2dkxQMnJNN3lESXVnZlVXYnpYMGNTUmxDUlJfMU8xZjg5WWlNYVJPRGNOR2dLSUdvaGprVVZxdjJCSUh1WU1xMmZ6UEtKd2dGbzlfYzE4U1hFaUhfbWl6aDZfamJTVzJaZkRyWmNyQ3hjZnNSZ2oxRlN0b0o0ekxNLVhMaTA2WE1zc3hxN24tZWc?oc=5). Advanced Navigation secured a $26 million deal with Kongsberg for C-UAS platforms [3](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxNc29vMUs2dkxQMnJNN3lESXVnZlVXYnpYMGNTUmxDUlJfMU8xZjg5WWlNYVJPRGNOR2dLSUdvaGprVVZxdjJCSUh1WU1xMmZ6UEtKd2dGbzlfYzE4U1hFaUhfbWl6aDZfamJTVzJaZkRyWmNyQ3hjZnNSZ2oxRlN0b0o0ekxNLVhMaTA2WE1zc3hxN24tZWc?oc=5). A new fleet of uncrewed surface vehicles was deployed from Australia's Hobart to monitor Southern Ocean carbon uptake [6](https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/aseanplus-news/2026/09/24/ocean-drones-deployed-to-monitor-southern-ocean-carbon-uptake#goog_rewarded).
